What this does not settle

  • 36 of 107 repeats do not settle inside the 5 s window. Mostly because the trace still wanders wider than the band where it is supposed to have arrived. Whether that is the robot or the rig is not established here; finding out means a longer DROP_MS, which costs coil heat at exactly the frequencies where heat is already the binding constraint.
  • The rise time is unavailable wherever the rise is short. The reported values sit against a 0.25 s smoother, so the faster ones carry about 10% of filter. A rise shorter than the smoother is refused rather than reported as the filter's own width.
  • The cone sitting at 1.00× the drive does not prove the rotor spins at the drive. The field itself rotates at that rate and can shake the robot whatever the rotor is doing. What it establishes is where the line is, which is all the filter needs to know.
  • The precession decay is not fitted. The envelope is plotted and tabulated; turning it into a damping coefficient is the obvious next measurement and is not done.
  • 40 Hz mixes two hold times and shows as two populations — two traces at 49° of swing against twelve at 11.5°. The median is quoted over both and should not be.
